Remove the model screenshot's blue environmental lighting and background while retaining the actual costume colors. Keep her petite Medium Female frame, compact torso and natural limb proportions matching the model.
Neutral acting: a serene, warmly attentive closed-mouth smile. Face nearly straight toward the viewer with a very slight natural head tilt, both eyes comfortably open and looking toward the same point. Eye design is essential in BOTH eyes. Keep two comfortably open eyes with clean continuous eyelid contours and intact pink-lilac irises, both looking toward the viewer. In the eye on the VIEWER'S LEFT, draw a small, delicate inward-curling spiral-shaped pupil inside the iris, matching the model. In the eye on the VIEWER'S RIGHT, draw the same small, delicate inward-curling spiral-shaped pupil inside its iris, also matching the model. BOTH pupils must visibly have this gentle curved swirl shape: two swirl pupils total, one per iris. Neither pupil is a plain circular dot. Make each curl subtle but readable, keeping most of each iris's color and shading intact. Preserve the pupil color shown in the source model. Keep highlights small and separate from the curled pupils, and preserve coherent iris boundaries, natural eyelids and a consistent gaze. The swirl is Mizuki's ordinary pupil design, contained within the irises. Let her shoulders relax, right forearm lowered with a softly open hand just away from her waist, left arm relaxed beside her hip with the hand clear of the sleeve. Both hands are empty. Stand with feet lightly staggered and uncrossed; hair and heavy sleeves hang naturally with gravity.
Hands should be naturally articulated: a connected palm, four fingers and a separate shorter opposable thumb, gently curved to suit the relaxed gesture. Keep clean hand silhouettes and a little space from adjacent fabric, allowing natural overlap rather than forcing every digit toward the camera.
Show the complete silhouette including hair, headpiece, hands, sleeves, costume ornaments and shoes with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding.
